text: Hi, I'm Memphis. In a C# engine, shaders usually live in another language, with another toolchain and another copy of your types. I wanted that gone.
Yotsuba Shader is a shader framework and compiler for C#. Plain C# classes, with your own types and libraries.
A source generator puts every binary inside your assembly at build time.
A command line takes your project file, for CI and content pipelines.
Whichever you pick, every shader exposes the same compiled code and reflection, so your engine loads any of them the same way.
It is free under the MIT License, and sponsors keep it maintained. Try the playground, and tell me what your engine needs.
